title: The Treatise of Ore and Stone
summary: A treatise on joining Metal with Earth, the two inert structural forces, so that ore and stone move as one body and answer to a single will.

title: A Manual of the Living Steel Body
summary: A manual for the cultivator who runs metal qi into the body path, so that sinew, bone and blade become one living steel.

title: The Canon of Iron Roots
summary: A canon in which the Core drives roots of metal into the ground and draws the earth up into spears, armor and quakes.

title: Compendium of the Steel Frame
summary: A compendium that fuses the Core's metal qi with the Body Cultivation Path and with the earth, building a frame of steel round the cultivator.
